33 bends and 420 torsions the 2024 file lacks for united-atom hydrocarbons, from Jorgensen, Madura & Swenson, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 106, 6638 (1984), Tables I and II (bench/ff/open/oplsua2024_supplement.json; each term's comment names its table and anything taken from the 2024 file); the 2024 file's own terms win

the 1984 torsions were fit with fixed bond lengths and angles, no 1-4 Lennard-Jones and a weak carbon-carbon term beyond 1-4 (eq 3: sigma 4 A, epsilon 0.0074 kcal/mol); here they run with the 2024 file's flexible bonds and its 1-4 x 0.5 scaling
